newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICA'S MHLABA TO RESIGN E.CAPE PREMIERSHIP.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICA'S MHLABA TO RESIGN E.CAPE PREMIERSHIP.

text.p: Eastern Cape Premier Raymond Mhlaba said on Thursday he would step down as provincial leader as soon as the African National Congress named his successor.

Mhlaba, a long-serving member of the ruling ANC and friend of President Nelson Mandela, said it was time to hand over the leadership to a younger person and added that his decision had not resulted from "undue pressure", state radio reported.

The move is seen as clearing the way for the ANC's chief whip in parliament, Arnold Stofile, who is said to be the only candidate for the premiership. Stofile is due to be sworn in as the ANC's Eastern Cape chairman at its congress on Friday.
